faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about Seedance AI video generation, supported workflows, credits, and model updates.

items.question: What can I generate with Seedance today?
items.answer: You can generate cinematic short videos from text prompts (Text to Video), animate static images with realistic motion (Image to Video), or use existing clips as motion and structural references (Video to Video). Seedance supports common aspect ratios (16:9, 9:16, 1:1) and resolutions up to 1080p.

items.question: How are generation credits calculated?
items.answer: Credit cost depends on the selected model, generation mode, duration, and resolution. The generator displays the estimated credit cost before you submit a generation task.

items.question: Can generated videos be used commercially?
items.answer: Commercial use depends on your active subscription plan, the underlying provider's model license terms, and applicable copyright law. Please review our Terms of Service before using generated videos for paid client work or commercial campaigns.

items.question: When will Seedance 2.5 be available on this site?
items.answer: This site currently provides video generation with Seedance 2.0 models. Seedance 2.5 is not yet integrated. For progress on Seedance 2.5 integration, visit the updates page.

items.question: What video resolutions and aspect ratios are supported?
items.answer: The generator supports popular landscape (16:9), portrait (9:16 for TikTok/Reels/Shorts), and square (1:1) aspect ratios, with resolutions ranging from standard preview up to 1080p HD depending on model configurations.
